Haseid is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One.
“
No such thing as coincidences when there's loot to be had.
„
— Haseid

Involvement

Act One

Haseid is in the Refectory inspecting the library for loot together with  Cefrey,  Barton, and  Torgga, while  Mari patrols the antechamber and  Andorn guards Chapel Entrance. Barton and the others are instantly hostile to the party.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Greatclub
Damage: 3~10
1d8 + 2⁠Bludgeoning
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Rage ( + )

Deal 2 extra damage with melee and improvised weapons, and throwing.

Gain Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.

 Range: Self
 Reckless Attack ()
Damage
Normal weapon damage
Throw all caution in the wind to gain  Advantage on your melee  Attack Roll.

Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you.

 Range: Normal weapon range
 Throw ()   –  Javelin
Damage: 3~8
1d6 + 2⁠Piercing

Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage.

The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage.

 Range: 3-18 m (10-60 ft)
